digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate evaluation and measurement infrastructure
propositions: Deterministic seeded-defect mutant corpus with 5 defect classes and golden-tested counting helpers (e2_counting.py) were designed and built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e2, intentionally not landed on main.

The ~100-run live LLM batch baseline sweep (run_e2_benchmark.py gate sweep and e2_baseline.json outputs) is permanently rejected on cost grounds and superseded by story d8a5's standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder that accumulates detection/FP signal at $0 marginal LLM cost from real production reviews.

Store-clone isolation mechanism (standalone git clone with own .git directory) was implemented by construction in run_e2_benchmark.py to prevent mutation commits from contaminating the real .tickets-tracker.
Pre-registered thresholds including ≥0.20 INDETERMINATE run-validity cap and per-class detection/blocking-FP targets were pinned in runs/e2_thresholds.json.
History-mining baseline approach is dead due to stranded history (only ~4 plan-v3 sidecar baselines exist vs ~200 needed after impact_model_version bump).
